title: US President Donald Trump Announces Phased 200% Tariff Policy on Generic Drug Imports
summary: Imposes zero-percent tariff for 2 years (from Aug 2026), 100% in Aug 2028, and 200% in Aug 2029.

blocks.content: Imposes zero-percent tariff for 2 years (from Aug 2026), 100% in Aug 2028, and 200% in Aug 2029.

items: Phased Tariff Schedule: 0% tariff (Aug 2026 – July 2028), 100% (Aug 2028 – July 2029), 200% (from Aug 2029).
India Impact: Impacts >40% of India's .5 billion generic pharma exports to the US.
